title: AuditRecord
description: The immutable record of an action having been attempted. The verification spine.

request_id.description: The ActionRequest.id this record accounts for.

intent.description: Echoed from the request for standalone readability of the log.

outcome.description: refused = a guard blocked it before execution (e.g. irreversible + no verifier).

result.description: Free-form result body: return value, error text, produced artifact ref. Any JSON type.

verified_by.description: Id of the independent verifier that cleared this, if any. Absent = unverified.
